title: False Dilemma Explained with The Simpsons — Logical Fallacies in TV Shows
skills: define and recognize the false dilemma fallacy
identify arguments that present only two options when more alternatives exist
evaluate whether a choice has been artificially narrowed
analyze arguments for logical completeness, fairness, and sound reasoning
alignment_note: Explains the false dilemma fallacy through a familiar television example, showing how arguments can mislead by presenting only two choices when additional options exist. Supports logical-fallacy recognition, rhetorical analysis, critical thinking, argument evaluation, and media literacy across high school English courses.
